title: More - tunes with q

chapters.title: General discussion
chapters.summary_seed: More than the greatest love the world has known, this is the love that I give to you alone. More than [music] the simple words I try to say, I only live to love you more each day. More [music] than you'll ever know, my arms long to hold you so. My life will be in your keeping, [music] waking, sleeping, laughing, weeping. Longer than always is a long, long time. [singing] But far beyond forever, you'll be mine. I know
